arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepaid_debit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made on cards whose card_type is 'Debit (Prepaid)', whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit cards' means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'; plain 'Debit' cards are excluded.
The count covers all transactions, including those with no fraud label, since the question asks how many were made.
The count covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
